name: Gravity Flip
description: Gravity switches off and everything, them included, falls up into the sky.
camera: Handheld medium-wide shot of the character {place}, looking at the camera.

beats.action: The character stands relaxed. Small loose things nearby begin to tremble and lift a little off the ground.
Gravity reverses. The character's feet leave the ground and they rise slowly, arms out and hair floating upward, while loose objects tumble up past them.
The camera tilts up and follows them as they drift higher into the open sky, calm and amused, looking back down at the lens.

product: The product items float up beside them, turning slowly and staying in sharp focus.
sound: a rising low hum, ambience fading away, soft airy wind, a light dreamy synth.
